links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified neurosurgical patient education materials (336 PEMs), compared before vs after GPT-4.0 simplification to a seventh grade level
links.outcome: Readability across 6 indices (Flesch-Kincaid Grade, Flesch Reading Ease, Gunning Fog, ARI, Coleman-Liau, SMOG)
links.effect: Substantial readability improvement across all 6 indices and all neurosurgical topics (P < .001); exact index values not given in the abstract
links.tradeoff: Unmonitored tone drift: sentiment shifted toward positivity (higher VADER compound scores, more positive tokens, fewer neutral tokens); disgust decreased significantly in every topic; sadness, surprise and joy increased modestly; fear and anger unchanged. Authors suggest a shift toward more persuasive language and recommend monitoring.
links.quote: Simplification produced substantial improvements in readability across all 6 indices and all neurosurgical topics (P < .001).

design_hint: reading-level constraint on LLM output with tone monitoring
